description: Purity policy for the semantic core, checked by `cargo xtask check-core-purity`. See ../decisions/ADR-0016-keep-a-pure-semantic-core.md. A new entry in allowed_dependencies is a reviewed architecture change.

forbidden_source_patterns.extern crate std: re-enables the standard library, and with it ambient effects, inside a no_std crate
forbidden_source_patterns.AtomicU: a static atomic is hidden global mutable state; pass state explicitly
forbidden_source_patterns.AtomicI: a static atomic is hidden global mutable state; pass state explicitly
forbidden_source_patterns.AtomicBool: a static atomic is hidden global mutable state; pass state explicitly
